news.title: AI Chip Startup Etched Eyes $20 Billion Valuation
news.snippet: Artificial intelligence chip startup Etched is reportedly preparing to quadruple...
news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence chip startup Etched is reportedly preparing to quadruple its valuation to around $20 billion. As The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported Friday (July 17), sources familiar with the matter say the company is capitalizing on a soaring market for venture capital investments in AI startups, and is also raising capital at a $10 billion valuation in a separate round led by Sequoia Capital. According to the report, Etched has said it is developing a chip for running AI models, otherwise known as inference. WSJ added that although Nvidia is the leading vendor of AI chips, a slew of startups is trying to compete following the success of Cerebras Systems and Groq. Many of the new startups are developing chips tailored for inference, while Nvidia’s dominance is based in the ability of its graphics processing units, or GPUs, to train AI models. *For all PYMNTS AI coverage, subscribe to the daily* AI Newsletter*.*.
